title: Microlayout Fabric: Component Density Spec and Legacy Rollout Reconciliation
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Background: As the Console surface has grown, multiple teams introduced bespoke density and spacing decisions for metric cards, rollout rails, and compact list states. This has created visual inconsistency and maintenance burden for engineers. Goal: Define a microlayout fabric (density tokens, component variants, and mapping rules) that reconciles legacy rollouts with the new token system, supports compact/regular/expanded density states, and meets accessibility contrast and hit-target requirements. Scope: - Create density token set (micro, compact, default, roomy) tied to spacing and typography scales. - Define component variant matrix for Card, Rail, MetricChip, and RolloutBanner with variant props and Figma components. - Author migration guidance for existing rollout rails and cost widgets so engineers can adopt tokens without regressions. Out-of-scope: full rework of charts and third-party embeds. Constraints: Must maintain existing performance budget for metrics grid rendering and preserve existing telemetry-driven breakpoints for rollouts. Decision drivers: engineering effort to refactor components, backwards compatibility for customer dashboards, and avoiding regressions in telemetry and unit tests.
acceptance_criteria: Density token set published in Figma and tokens repo with 4 named tokens (micro, compact, default, roomy)
Component variant library updated with Prop matrix for Card, MetricChip, RolloutBanner, and Rail and ready for handoff
Migration guide published with code snippets and a phased rollout plan for 3 major pages (Overview, Cost Explorer, Rollouts)
Contrast and hit-target checks done for micro and compact variants and documented with screenshots
Engineering spike PR demonstrating token-based Card and RolloutBanner merged to feature branch

2026-01-29 Accessibility-review: a11y engineer flagged insufficient contrast for metric chips in micro mode on dark theme; recommendation to nudge accent token or add subtle outline.
2026-02-01 PR feedback from frontend: prefer token naming with 'density.' prefix to align with style-dictionary conventions — will rename in final pass.
2026-02-02 Updated by Marc Liu: Consolidated handoff package uploaded; ready for stakeholder signoff. Requesting UX PM review before scheduling implementation sprint.
decisions: Adopt four density tokens (micro, compact, default, roomy) mapped to spacing scale 2/4/8/12 respectively.
Use 'density.' prefix for token names to match engineering conventions.
Keep rollout API unchanged; refactor presentation layer only to reduce backend risk.
Add 1px outline and slightly increased contrast for metric chips in micro dark theme to pass AA.
Phased migration: start with non-critical surfaces (internal dashboards), then cost explorer, then public rollouts.
Provide a feature flag for token opt-in and automated visual diff snapshots during rollout.
